description: Closes #386 (Outlook routing leg) — the Outlook specialist (#380/#382) is in the routing table but no case verified an Outlook query reaches it. must_route_to (outlook_agent) is the quality assertion. The negative list deliberately OMITS gmail_agent: Gmail-vs-Outlook disambiguation is the unstable axis under the 8th-handoff roster (see #405), so hard-gating 'not gmail' here would risk red-gating an unrelated PR before that regression is resolved. It keeps only the clearly-wrong-and-stable prohibitions (web_agent / browser_agent) — an email query must never land on public-web navigation. DOGFOOD 2026-07-08: 20/20 on the live-Gemini 20x grid — flipped to single_run_gate:true (gates on quality now, keeping the gmail_agent omission from must_not_route_to).
